newsitem.title: PERU: Peru stocks close lightly off in speculative trade.
newsitem.headline: Peru stocks close lightly off in speculative trade.

text.p: The Lima Stock Exchange made slight overall losses Friday in a session of speculative trading, brokers said.
They predicted stability at the beginning of next week as investors wait for latest macroeconomic indicators.

According to preliminary figures, the bolsa's General Index fell 0.15 percent to 2,174.10 points, while the blue-chip index edged down 0.07 percent to 3,131.34 on volume of 46 million soles ($17.5 million) in 2,252 trades.
Brokers said small gains at the beginning of Friday's session were offset by profit-taking at the close.
"The session became speculative before the close as many investors began to sell shares that had posted some interesting gains in the first half," said Manuel Torres of Finvest brokerage.
He added that the speculative trading would be only "something momentary" given that Peru's long-term fundamentals remain good.
Among losers, polymetallic miner Morococha fell 0.79 percent to 6.30 soles, while fellow miner Milpo lost 0.62 percent to 40 soles.
Benchmark Telefnica del Per also slipped back 0.56 percent to 7.07 soles. Telefnica's fall followed a downgrade by Santander Investment to market perform from buy.
